title: NovaNote Cloud Workspace — Fictional Privacy Policy & Terms
description: A fictional privacy policy created for deterministic testing of PrivacyLens prompt versions. Includes explicit data collection/sharing clauses, intentionally vague/risky clauses, and an intentional omission of data retention duration.
policyText:
NOVANOTE LABS PRIVACY POLICY
Effective Date: January 15, 2026

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
When you register for NovaNote Cloud Workspace, we collect your full name, email address, billing postal code, and device identifiers. While you use our note-taking editor, we also collect usage telemetry, keystroke timing metadata, and approximate geolocation derived from your IP address. If you enable voice-to-text notes, we temporarily process your audio recordings.

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
We use the collected information to provide and synchronize your workspace across devices, process subscription payments, troubleshoot technical errors, and train our proprietary text-prediction and automated summarization algorithms.

3. SHARING OF INFORMATION WITH THIRD PARTIES
We share your email address and device identifiers with third-party advertising networks and analytics partners to measure campaign performance and deliver tailored promotions across external websites. We may also transfer user account data to corporate affiliates or an acquiring entity in the event of a merger, reorganization, or asset sale.

4. USER RIGHTS AND CHOICES
You may request a copy of your account profile data or ask us to delete your account by emailing privacy-requests@novanote.example. However, copies of notes that have already been incorporated into our aggregated machine-learning training sets cannot be retroactively removed after deletion.

5. POLICY UPDATES AND DISPUTES
We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time at our sole discretion without prior individual notice; continued use of NovaNote constitutes acceptance of any updated terms. By using the service, you waive the right to participate in any class-action lawsuit and agree that all disputes shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration.
